openai/whisper-large-v3.description: OpenAI Whisper large v3 via Together's OpenAI-compatible transcription API
openai/whisper-large-v3.pricingTier: Together AI serverless batch transcription pricing
openai/whisper-large-v3.pricingNotes: Together AI Whisper batch transcription is billed at $0.0015/audio minute, equivalent to $0.09/hour. Free credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Together documents a 500 MB direct-upload limit, a 1 GB public-URL fetch limit, and a four-hour audio-duration limit for batch transcription. AutoShow currently sends local multipart uploads, so the 500 MB direct-upload limit is effective.

nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.description: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 via Together's serverless batch transcription API
nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.pricingTier: Together AI serverless batch transcription pricing
nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.pricingNotes: Together AI Parakeet batch transcription is billed at $0.0015/audio minute, equivalent to $0.09/hour. The reused Whisper timing estimate is provisional until Phase 7 benchmarking completes. Free credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Together documents a 500 MB direct-upload limit, a 1 GB public-URL fetch limit, and a four-hour audio-duration limit for batch transcription. A 2026-08-03 Parakeet benchmark rejected a 103 MB multipart request but accepted approximately 20 MB split requests, so AutoShow applies a conservative 20 MiB operational cap while retaining the documented direct-upload limit as provenance. Parakeet accepts prompt for API compatibility but ignores it, so AutoShow omits that field for this model.
